common_name: SunPatiens Compact Red Impatiens (Sun-Tolerant Season-Long Bedding Impatiens)

planting.note: Set out transplants after the last frost into full sun to partial shade in fertile, well-drained soil; SunPatiens tolerates full sun and heat without wilting and resists the downy mildew that devastates standard impatiens plantings.

directions: Plant in full sun to partial shade in fertile, well-drained soil and feed regularly through the growing season to keep the dense, well-branched mound covered in bloom. SunPatiens Compact Red is a vegetatively propagated, downy-mildew-resistant hybrid bred to shrug off full sun and summer heat that would collapse traditional Impatiens walleriana, producing saturated true-red flowers against glossy dark green foliage all season. Its compact, tidy habit suits smaller beds, mixed containers, and foundation plantings better than the larger Vigorous SunPatiens line, while still delivering the same nonstop color. Keep soil consistently moist through establishment and the hottest weeks of summer for the most continuous bloom.
sources: University of Florida IFAS Extension — Bedding Plant Trials

common_name: SunPatiens Compact White Impatiens (Sun-Tolerant Season-Long Bedding Impatiens)

planting.note: Set out transplants after the last frost into full sun to partial shade in fertile, well-drained soil; SunPatiens tolerates full sun and heat without wilting and resists the downy mildew that devastates standard impatiens plantings.

directions: Plant in full sun to partial shade in fertile, well-drained soil and feed regularly through the season to sustain the vigorous, self-cleaning growth this series is bred for. SunPatiens Compact White is a vegetatively propagated, downy-mildew-resistant hybrid that tolerates full sun and heat that would scorch traditional Impatiens walleriana, holding a dense mound of clean white flowers over glossy dark green foliage from spring through frost. Its bright, reflective color makes it especially useful for brightening deep shade corners or evening gardens, while its full-sun tolerance also lets it anchor mixed beds where light levels vary through the day. The Compact series stays more restrained than the larger Vigorous SunPatiens line, fitting well into smaller beds, borders, and containers.
sources: University of Florida IFAS Extension — Bedding Plant Trials
